hoaxes.title: SemiAnalysis's new GDPx benchmark adds a round where AI models must assemble flat-pack furniture
hoaxes.truth: Made up. GDPx tests 11 fields, including chip design, cybersecurity, biology and quant trading, and the top score is 12%.

hoaxes.title: Clayface screenings hand every ticket buyer a lump of modelling clay to shape during the credits
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Clayface led the worldwide box office in its second weekend, reaching about $83 million globally.

hoaxes.title: Nintendo's Switch 2 Lite will ship with a detachable kickstand shaped like a Pikmin
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The rumored Switch 2 Lite is reported to have a 7.1-inch screen, a price near $299 and no TV output.

hoaxes.title: Apple's touchscreen MacBook Pro hides a stylus garage inside its hinge
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple's first touchscreen Macs, OLED MacBook Pros from $2,899, go on sale November 6.
